conversations_document_active_key.name: conversations_document_active_key
conversations_document_active_key.where: "conversations"."document_id" is not null and "conversations"."deleted_at" is null

conversations_subject_len.name: conversations_subject_len
conversations_subject_len.value: "conversations"."subject" is null or char_length("conversations"."subject") between 1 and 80

conversations_topic_len.name: conversations_topic_len
conversations_topic_len.value: "conversations"."topic" is null or char_length("conversations"."topic") between 1 and 120

quiz_attempts_score_valid.name: quiz_attempts_score_valid
quiz_attempts_score_valid.value: "quiz_attempts"."score" is null or ("quiz_attempts"."total" is not null and "quiz_attempts"."score" between 0 and "quiz_attempts"."total")

quiz_questions_topic_len.name: quiz_questions_topic_len
quiz_questions_topic_len.value: "quiz_questions"."topic" is null or char_length("quiz_questions"."topic") between 1 and 100

quiz_questions_options_shape.name: quiz_questions_options_shape
quiz_questions_options_shape.value: ("quiz_questions"."question_type" in ('mcq', 'true_false') and jsonb_typeof("quiz_questions"."options") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("quiz_questions"."options") between 2 and 6) or ("quiz_questions"."question_type" in ('short_answer', 'numerical') and "quiz_questions"."options" is null)

viva_answers_scores_valid.name: viva_answers_scores_valid
viva_answers_scores_valid.value: "viva_answers"."correctness" between 0 and 10 and "viva_answers"."completeness" between 0 and 10 and "viva_answers"."clarity" between 0 and 10 and "viva_answers"."confidence" between 0 and 10

viva_sessions_completed_consistent.name: viva_sessions_completed_consistent
viva_sessions_completed_consistent.value: ("viva_sessions"."status" = 'completed') = ("viva_sessions"."completed_at" is not null and "viva_sessions"."score" is not null)
